estimand: ratio of full-precision pooled medians across all 516*5=2580 observations per arm
strata: Six 3-arm permutation strata of 86 rounds each (516 total). Draw 86 round IDs with replacement per stratum; use identical joint 516 round IDs across all cases, operations, and arms.
cluster: Whole 3-arm round across all six cases, four operations, three arms, and all five observations.
raw_pooled_recomputation: All 72 arm/case/operation medians independently matched statistics.median over raw JSON observations
limitations: Nominal familywise 95% percentile-bootstrap intervals with Bonferroni-48 (combined) and Bonferroni-24 (historical per-baseline) adjustments; finite bootstrap approximation and independent/exchangeable rounds within permutation strata assumed. Single host/session may retain temporal correlation; not a universal population guarantee.
